support.faqQuestion1: How do I connect a new laptop or presentation screen?
support.faqAnswer1: Install the MakeChurchEazy desktop app, sign in, then open Devices in the dashboard to pair the computer. If you are not using OBS, copy the presentation link from presentation mode and open it on the screen you want to project.
support.faqAnswer2: AI credits are used for features such as Speech to Scripture and translation. Usage depends on the feature and the amount of text or audio processed. You can check your balance on the Credits page.
support.faqQuestion3: Can I use the app offline?
support.faqAnswer3: Most presentation work can continue locally after your songs, Bible versions, media, and themes are ready. Internet is needed for sign-in, syncing, downloads, updates, AI tools, and billing.
support.faqQuestion4: How do I change my plan?
support.faqAnswer4: Go to Subscription > Plans to compare Free, Basic, and Growth. Upgrades unlock the matching limits and credits for that plan after payment is confirmed.
support.subtitle: Find setup steps, service-day fixes, and contact options for your church presentation workflow.

support.faqQ1: How do I connect a new laptop or presentation screen?
support.faqA1: Install the MakeChurchEazy desktop app, sign in, then open Devices in the dashboard to pair the computer. For projection without OBS, copy the presentation link from presentation mode and open it on the screen you want to project.
support.faqA2: AI credits power Speech to Scripture, translations, and other AI tools. Each feature consumes credits based on the work done. Check your balance and history on the Credits page.
support.faqQ3: How do I connect MakeChurchEazy to OBS?
support.faqA3: Open the desktop app settings, enter your OBS WebSocket host, port, and password, then connect. You can also use the presentation browser link when you want to project without controlling OBS.
support.faqQ4: How do I change my plan or billing?
support.faqA4: Open Subscription > Plans to view Free, Basic, and Growth. When an upgrade is confirmed, the matching plan limits and credits should apply to the account.
support.faqA5: Your account uses secure authentication and encrypted network connections. You can review active sessions, passwords, and connected devices from the Security and Devices pages.
support.faqQ6: Can I use MakeChurchEazy on multiple screens?
support.faqA6: Yes. You can use OBS browser sources, the presentation browser link, or an extended display depending on how your service computer and projector are set up.
support.faqQ7: What internet speed do I need?
support.faqA7: Local presentation actions should stay responsive on the same machine or local network. Internet is mainly needed for sign-in, syncing, downloads, updates, AI features, and billing.
support.faqQ8: How do I reset my password?
support.faqA8: Go to the login page, choose Forgot Password, and enter your email. If you signed up with Google, use the Google sign-in option instead.

support.quickStartDesc: Use these steps before Sunday so the desktop app, devices, and presentation output are ready.
support.stepDownloadDesc: Download the latest build for the laptop that will control the service.
support.stepPairDesc: Connect the desktop app to this dashboard so plans, credits, and devices stay in sync.
support.stepPrepareDesc: Import worship songs, add Bible versions, upload media, and choose backgrounds before service.
support.stepPresentDesc: Use OBS if you have it, or copy the browser link to another laptop or extended screen.
support.serviceHelpDesc: When service is about to start, use the fastest stable option first.
support.serviceHelpOne: If OBS is not ready, copy the presentation link and open it on the projector screen.
support.serviceHelpTwo: Keep the control laptop and presentation screen on the same local network for browser link updates.
support.serviceHelpThree: If a song, image, or video does not show, reload the presentation page and select the item again from the dock.
support.serviceHelpFour: If AI suggestions are slow, continue manually with the Bible or worship tabs and check credits after service.
support.contactDesc: Send the details, screenshots, and the service time so we can help quickly.

support.noResultsDesc: Try searching for OBS, presentation, billing, device, songs, media, or credits.
support.noFaqResults: No matching questions found. Try a different search term.
support.noResourceResults: No matching resource cards found. Check the FAQ results below or try another search term.
support.guideSupportNote: If this still does not work, send support the exact step that failed and a screenshot of what you see.
support.guideGeneralIntro: Use this page as your quick help desk. Pick the topic closest to your problem, read the short steps, then continue from the dashboard or desktop app.
support.guideGeneralStepOne: Use the search box to find the area you need: presentation, OBS, songs, media, devices, billing, or credits.
support.guideGeneralStepTwo: Open the card that matches the job. Cards with setup help open a simple guide here instead of leaving the app.
support.guideGeneralStepThree: For urgent service problems, use the Service-day quick fixes section first.
support.guideGeneralStepFour: If you need a person to check it, email support with the church name, device, and screenshot.
support.guidePresentationIntro: This is for showing Bible verses, worship lyrics, images, videos, and countdowns on the screen people see.
support.guidePresentationStepOne: If you use OBS, add the MakeChurchEazy browser source in OBS and keep it visible in your presentation scene.
support.guidePresentationStepTwo: If you do not use OBS, open presentation mode in the desktop app and copy the browser link.
support.guidePresentationStepThree: Open that link on the projector laptop, browser tab, or extended display you want the audience to see.
support.guidePresentationStepFour: Keep the control laptop and display screen on the same local network so every dock click updates the screen quickly.
support.guideSongsIntro: Use this when you want to bring in worship songs and make each verse, chorus, or bridge easy to show during service.
support.guideSongsStepOne: Open the desktop app library and choose the song import option.
support.guideSongsStepTwo: Paste lyrics or import a supported file, then review the detected sections before saving.
support.guideSongsStepThree: Keep section names simple, such as Verse 1, Chorus, Bridge, and Ending, so volunteers can find them fast.
support.guideSongsStepFour: During service, open the Worship tab in the dock and click the section you want to show.
support.guideMediaIntro: Use this for images, videos, countdown screens, and background changes shown on the presentation output.
support.guideMediaStepOne: Upload the image or video from the desktop app media area.
support.guideMediaStepTwo: Choose the media item in the dock when you want it to appear on the screen.
support.guideMediaStepThree: Use backgrounds for Bible and worship slides when you want text over an image, color, or video.
support.guideMediaStepFour: Use countdowns before service or during transitions, then stop or replace them when you are ready to continue.
support.guidePrepareIntro: Do these checks before people arrive so the service flow is ready and volunteers do not have to rush.
support.guidePrepareStepOne: Open the desktop app and confirm the right church account is signed in.
support.guidePrepareStepTwo: Check that songs, Bible versions, media, and backgrounds needed for the service are already loaded.
support.guidePrepareStepThree: Open the presentation output through OBS or the browser link and test one Bible verse, one song section, and one media item.
support.guidePrepareStepFour: Keep the support page open if you are training a volunteer or setting up a new service laptop.

supportExtended.faq1Question: How do I connect a new laptop or presentation screen?
supportExtended.faq1Answer: Install the MakeChurchEazy desktop app, sign in, then open Devices in the dashboard to pair the computer. If you are not using OBS, copy the presentation link from presentation mode and open it on the screen you want to project.
supportExtended.faq2Answer: AI credits are used for features such as Speech to Scripture and translation. Usage depends on the feature and the amount of text or audio processed. You can check your balance on the Credits page.
supportExtended.faq3Question: Can I use the app offline?
supportExtended.faq3Answer: Most presentation work can continue locally after your songs, Bible versions, media, and themes are ready. Internet is needed for sign-in, syncing, downloads, updates, AI tools, and billing.
supportExtended.faq4Question: How do I change my plan?
supportExtended.faq4Answer: Go to Subscription > Plans to compare Free, Basic, and Growth. Upgrades unlock the matching limits and credits for that plan after payment is confirmed.
